title: install-local dryRun re-install: answerUpgradeDryRun calls planUpgrade unguarded, so a stored copy the resolver refuses throws instead of being answered
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsS4GoHCgYwA2uv3n3C

Filing gate: class a, an out-of-scope finding of the #34583 dev round (PR #34844, report 6949492912), measured by that dev with a throwaway probe. ⛔ Not a claim. Grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

Suggested-grade: p2 · the same family as #34583 and #34432 (install-local answers a resolver refusal)

## 维护者速读

- 现象：本地安装接口带 `dryRun: true` 重装一个包时，如果「已经装着的那份」被今天的校验拒收，接口不是回一个说清原因的 422，而是直接抛错。代码库自己的记录(#34574 的测试头注)说，这种抛错到传输层会变成 500。
- 为什么要修：真装一次走的是 #34583 修好的那条路，会回 422 并点名已装副本；预演却抛错。同一个包，预演和真装的回答不一样。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## What (reported by the dev, read from code; the 500 not re-measured)

`answerUpgradeDryRun` (private, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`) calls `manifest.planUpgrade(installed, incoming)` without the pre-resolve that step 2c″ does. With a booted ObjectQLPlugin's `planUpgrade` (objectql `planPackageUpgrade` → `sideOf` → `resolveStackCollection`), a stored copy that still carries the retired bare `indexes[].unique: true` made the handler THROW `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY` 422 instead of answering. This was measured at the handler at `32bda83ef0`. The transport renders it as 500 according to #34574's real-runtime test header; that part was not re-measured.

## Change (suggested by the dev)

Pre-resolve each side the way 2c″ does after PR #34844, and answer with `declaredRefusalAnswer(manifestId, err, side)`. Pin it like PR #34844's pins: installed refused, incoming refused, and a CONTROL.

## Notes

- Open PR #34791 also touches this file. Run the overlap check at claim time.
- Lands after PR #34844, which adds the `side` argument this reuses.

Dedupe: `answerUpgradeDryRun` (4 hits, none open on this), `install-local dry run planUpgrade refused` (6 hits; only #34583 open, the sibling).

Blocked-by: #34583
